LanguageData.OA_PortableCommsConsoleDesc: Use {0} to contact the Golden Iris Empire.
LanguageData.OA_CircuitRegulatorRepairmentTooltipDesc:
The stability of {0}'s circuit will gradually decrease. If {0} bears a larger load, the stability of the circuit will decrease faster. 

If the stability of the circuit drops to 0%, {0} will enter a failure state and cannot share the load of the power grid. 

The construction union automatically repairs {0} and controls its circuit stability within a safe range. Once its circuit stability falls below {LEVEL}, they will repair it.
LanguageData.OA_CircuitRegulatorRepairmentTooltipDisa: The automatic repair function is currently disabled. After use, construction workers will repair {0}.
LanguageData.OA_CircuitRegulatorRepairmentToggleToolt: Determine whether automatic maintenance will be performed on {0} when its circuit stability is below {LEVEL}. \The automatic repair is currently {ONOFF}.
